principle: Hub PROFILES — the system-facing map of every Open*Hub as a DIRECTORY the compiler/runtime pulls from. Each profile declares the TYPES of rules / context / modules pullable from that hub, its substrate, and an example pull. This is what lets the model understand the scale + the directories. Distinct from candidate_open_hubs.json (release/brand policy) and products.js (brand display): this is the pullable-capability map. Hub ids cross-validate against candidate_open_hubs (existing + candidates) so the map can't drift. serves_truth=false (hubs register rules/pointers/shapes, never truth or a data dump).
